reuse.why: Reuses findOrCreateBank, handleSyncResponse and turns the Akahu downloader into a parameterised downloader for Fintegra; but the local unlink in claimBankAccount re-states unlinkAccount's field reset instead of sharing it.

duplication.why: linkFintegraAccount is a near line-for-line copy of linkAkahuAccount's upgrade/insert/sync body, and claimBankAccount repeats unlinkAccount's db.updateAccount field-clearing block.

placement.why: The one-link rule lives in accounts/link.ts beside findOrCreateBank and is called first in every provider's link handler; downloader and server path changes sit in sync.ts and server-config.ts where their siblings are.

scope.why: All edits serve the four steps (unique link, Fintegra provider, closed-account refusal, replaceExistingLink) plus tests and types.

maintainability.why: A single claimBankAccount guard used by all six link handlers is easy to own; the copied Fintegra link body and the second copy of the unlink field list are what a maintainer would have to keep in step.

bypasses_abstraction.where: Every provider link handler routes through claimBankAccount; the downloader reuse goes through the new shared downloadAkahuStyleTransactions.

disguised_duplication.where: The duplicated Fintegra link body and the unlink field reset are plain copies, not renamed or reshaped.

abstraction_drift.where: claimBankAccount grows a replaceExistingLink parameter with an unlink-instead-of-throw branch, and a closed-upgrading-account check is bolted onto the same guard; all link handlers call it.
